target: Same-height, nonfinal eager Blake2s prefix calls reuse one state bank. Growing-height and final tree calls retain separate banks. Apply the same plan in trace commits and PCS late source rebuild.

evidence.source: failed headline node9 GPU_DEVICE_PEAK/GPU_TRACE_STREAM; an allocation receipt, not exact node peak
evidence.callback_scope: one observed INTER trace-commit callback after failed admission wait, not isolated kernel time

expected_effect.label: E
expected_effect.reason: Lower the owned scratch and future envelope; possible overlap benefit. Same-height prefix transforms retain arithmetic and traffic, so no large direct kernel-speed claim.
expected_effect.limitations: This alone does not close11GB. Full INTER numerator storage, permanent tail and PCS phase-sum envelope remain.

source_safety.loads: All hash and live pending seed words load into thread-local initial state before prefix stores.
source_safety.stores: Eager SoA output word k,row is k*size+row. Different row threads do not share an address at equal sizes.
source_safety.contract: Current mixed_seeded_on rejects all overlaps. Add a specific exact-pointer, equal-height, eager-prefix-only entry; retain the original entry rejection contract. Never allow final output or growing-height aliasing.

validation: Static plan parity and byte-budget comparisons for repeated heights, height growth and final parity.
Numerical exact-alias vs disjoint-prefix tests across pending alignments, height changes and finalization; explicit rejection of shifted overlaps and final output alias.
Pod-only build, small whole-stack proof parity and fresh receivers; then canonical3+3 with separate profile. No same-source schedule cherry-picking.
Before commit run full correctness gate and update ledger/scope; P1 stays open unless all required exits are independently proved.
decision: stream-compact-state-census.json models872415264 fewer bytes with the current disjoint schedule. Adding exact-alias support provides no additional saving for this logged geometry, so do not implement aliasing first.
